about: The validator probes of X12, the fail-closed phase of scripts/live/native_parity.py (tasks/m22-spec.md X12; O34, O51): each sets `fields` on the harness's parity request (model, messages, max_tokens, temperature 0, stream false) and must get HTTP 400 with `code` at `param` from the native profile's validator, leaving native_submissions unchanged. The harness sends them in this order, then its over-length probe (context_length_exceeded). Each probe is outside the native subset today; `outside` names the validate.rs check and the capabilities field that keep it there. Checked against the real validator on configs/runtime/native-g0.toml and the snapshot profile (crates/cere-runtime/tests/back_validate.rs x12_probes_are_refused_by_the_shipped_native_profiles) and against their capabilities files (tests/test_native_parity.py test_x12_probes_each_set_a_field_the_capabilities_do_not_serve).
